lines.text: The man who fears the LORD greatly delights in His commandments, and his descendants will be mighty in the land.
A river flows in the darkness for the upright, and wealth and riches are in his house.
It is well with the generous man who lends freely, and the righteous man will be remembered forever.
He does not fear bad news because he trusts in the LORD, and he scatters gifts to the rulers.
The wicked man will see and be grieved, gnash his teeth and waste away, and his desires will perish.
